notes: All shop-window illustrations, frame-tree geometry, seeded layouts, interaction controls, rasterization, and replay grading are original HTML/CSS/JavaScript/Python work. No source code, task media, screenshots, slide files, SwiftUI projects, or frontend assets are copied.
